text:
alex: Quick heads-up — finalizing the cut runbook + go/no-go sync for the 3/22 cut. Need RSVP + owners for smoke, rollback, and DB migration checks.

maya: I can own the runbook walkthrough. Will add steps to the doc and highlight manual rollback points.

sam: I can take smoke verification and perf sanity. Prefer the 09:30 PT slot.

jin: I can do DB migration validation (pre-cut checklist + backstop plan). Need the migration window in the runbook.

lia: I’ll cover infra rollback and KMS key checks. Adding my checklist items now.

alex: Thanks — can folks confirm attendance and whether you want a spot on the agenda for a 10m walkthrough? Current agenda draft below.

release-bot: Reminder: Cut freeze time is 2024-03-22 08:00 UTC. Auto-notice will go to oncall 2h prior.

maya: Agenda looks good. Suggest adding a short "regressions to watch" section for the evals.

sam: +1 to regressions watchlist. Also can we add a quick canary traffic target (5% for 20m)?

alex: Updated agenda with both suggestions. Proposed meeting windows (PT): 08:30, 09:30, 11:00. Please reply with preferred slot and whether you want a speaking 10m block.

jin: 09:30 works. I need the DB migration owner ping 24h before so I can run prechecks.

lia: 09:30 or 11:00 for me. If 09:30, I might join a few minutes late.

maya: 09:30 PT good, I’ll take the 10m walkthrough.

sam: 09:30 PT and I’ll take the 10m smoke report.

alex: Sounds like a tentative majority for 09:30 PT. Finalize by EOD today — if no objections, booking that slot and sending calendar invites.

ops-bot: Action created: "Finalize runbook + assign owners" assigned to @maya, due 2024-03-21 16:00 UTC.

alex: Quick checklist snippet (will paste into runbook):
```
- Pre-cut: prod snapshot & backup
- DB migration dry-run on staging + data check
- Canary: 5% traffic x 20m, validate 200/latency/regressions
- Full cut rollback plan documented & tested
- Post-cut smoke: basic flows, auth, billing, ingestion
```

maya: I added the exact command for backup and the staging dry-run steps. See section 2.2.

sam: PR for the smoke script landed: https://git.redwood.com/r/smoke/PR-431 — can someone review quickly? small bash tweak.

jin: Reviewing now.

lia: Quick Q: who’s oncall during the cut? need phone roster for the runbook.

alex: Oncall list: @jin, @lia, @ops (ops rotation) — adding full pager contacts to runbook now.

maya: I’ll also upload the runbook PDF to the release drive once finalized.

sam: Two minor asks: 1) canary metrics dashboard link in the notes, 2) alert thresholds to temporarily relax during cut? (we can set mute for noisy alerts)

alex: Adding dashboard link + suggested mute policy. Anyone object to temporarily silencing deploy noise alerts for 30m during canary? no objections noted.

release-bot: RSVP summary (so far): alex (host), maya (walkthrough), sam (smoke), jin (DB), lia (infra). Pending: security rep, QA lead.

security-rep: I can join for the 10m security sign-off if added — 09:30 PT works for me.

qa-lead: I’ll join the post-cut 15m smoke in case we need deeper tests. 09:30 PT okay.

alex: Great. Final asks before I lock the invite: anyone need a different cut time? Any blockers for runbook items flagged as high priority?

maya: None from my side. Filing one small doc bug now.

sam: No blockers. PR review incoming.

jin: DB migration dry-run scheduled for 2024-03-21 03:00 PT — will report results in this thread.

lia: Adding phone roster + escalation matrix to runbook.

alex: Alright I'll book 09:30 PT for the go/no-go sync and send invites to participants listed. If you must opt out, reply here before EOD.

sam: :thumbsup:

maya: :raised_hands:

jin: On it.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Cut 2024-03-22 — go/no-go sync" 2024-03-22 09:30 PT. Invite sent to participants.

alex: Thanks all — closing thread and moving action items to the runbook. If anything urgent, ping me or update the runbook directly.
